MinGW runtime DLLs bundled locally for CAPSIMG

Unmodified official MSYS2 packages, verified against the published SHA-256.
Only the required libstdc++, libgcc and winpthread DLLs are included.
The original licenses accompany them. No global PATH changes are made.

GCC source/build package:
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-gcc-16.2.0-6.src.tar.zst
GCC source repository: https://gcc.gnu.org/git/gitweb.cgi?p=gcc.git
MSYS2 build recipes: https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages/tree/master/mingw-w64-gcc
Winpthreads source/build packages:
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-winpthreads-14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-2.src.tar.zst
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-winpthreads-14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-1.src.tar.zst
